comment: Space repo exports (STAR-lite v1, profile atproto-space-repo): archives the reference serializeRepo writes, and invalid ones, with the verdict of the reference verifyRepoStarFull(archive, {repo, space, sharedSecret, mac}). `archive` is hex, or segments for Vectors.Hex. `star` is the bare STAR layer verdict (reference readStar, pairs drained, no profile checks).

cases.name: empty repo
cases.note: SPC-59/60: metadata only; data is the digest of the empty LtHash.

cases.name: records needing byte ordering
cases.note: SPC-59: keys in strictly increasing byte order: com.example.a.b/x precedes com.example.a/A ("." < "/"), and A < a < a-b < a.b < a:b < a_b < a~b.

cases.name: a record of every data type
cases.note: SPC-17/59: text, integers, booleans, null, arrays, nested maps, bytes and a CID link, canonically encoded.

cases.name: a record of exactly 1 MiB
cases.note: SPC-59: a record value is at most 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes).

cases.name: rev that is not a TID
cases.note: SPC-77 says rev is a TID; the reference metadata schema takes any string, and SPC-60 does not list rev among the checks.

cases.name: metadata with an extra field
cases.note: SPC-59 lists the metadata fields; the reference ignores unknown ones (its schema strips them).

cases.name: MAC under another secret
cases.note: SPC-60: a MAC mismatch rejects the archive.

cases.name: MAC over another rev
cases.note: SPC-60.

cases.name: another repo requested
cases.note: SPC-60/77: repo must equal the request.

cases.name: another space requested
cases.note: SPC-60/77: space must equal the request.

cases.name: commit ver 2
cases.note: SPC-60/77: ver is 1 (the MAC does not cover ver, so it matches).

cases.name: metadata $type of another profile
cases.note: SPC-59/60: the metadata is $type "atproto-space-repo" plus the commit fields.
cases.referenceError: RepoVerificationError: invalid repo metadata: [ { "received": "atproto-space-records", "code": "invalid_literal", "expected": "atproto-space-repo", "path": [ "$type" ], "message": "Invalid literal val

cases.name: metadata without $type
cases.note: SPC-59/60: the metadata is $type "atproto-space-repo" plus the commit fields.

star.error: StarParseError: metadata must be a map with a $type

cases.referenceError: StarParseError: metadata must be a map with a $type

cases.name: metadata without rev
cases.note: SPC-59/60: the metadata is $type "atproto-space-repo" plus the commit fields.

cases.name: metadata without data
cases.note: SPC-59/60: the metadata is $type "atproto-space-repo" plus the commit fields.
cases.referenceError: RepoVerificationError: invalid repo metadata: [ { "code": "custom", "message": "Input not instance of Uint8Array", "fatal": true, "path": [ "data" ] } ]

cases.name: metadata data as a string
cases.note: SPC-59/60: the metadata is $type "atproto-space-repo" plus the commit fields.
cases.referenceError: RepoVerificationError: invalid repo metadata: [ { "code": "custom", "message": "Input not instance of Uint8Array", "fatal": true, "path": [ "data" ] } ]

cases.name: metadata ver as a string
cases.note: SPC-59/60: the metadata is $type "atproto-space-repo" plus the commit fields.
cases.referenceError: RepoVerificationError: invalid repo metadata: [ { "code": "invalid_type", "expected": "number", "received": "string", "path": [ "ver" ], "message": "Expected number, received string" } ]

cases.name: metadata repo that is not a DID
cases.note: SPC-59/60: the metadata is $type "atproto-space-repo" plus the commit fields.
cases.referenceError: RepoVerificationError: invalid repo metadata: [ { "code": "custom", "fatal": true, "path": [ "repo" ], "message": "Invalid input" } ]

cases.name: metadata space that is not a space reference
cases.note: SPC-59/60: the metadata is $type "atproto-space-repo" plus the commit fields.
cases.referenceError: RepoVerificationError: invalid repo metadata: [ { "code": "custom", "fatal": true, "path": [ "space" ], "message": "Invalid input" } ]

cases.name: metadata with keys out of canonical order
cases.note: SPC-59: the metadata is canonical DRISL.

star.error: StarParseError: metadata is not canonical DRISL

cases.referenceError: StarParseError: metadata is not canonical DRISL

cases.name: metadata with trailing bytes
cases.note: SPC-59: the metadata frame holds exactly one item.

cases.name: metadata that is an array
cases.note: SPC-59.

star.error: StarParseError: metadata must be a map with a $type

cases.referenceError: StarParseError: metadata must be a map with a $type

cases.note: SPC-59.

cases.note: SPC-59: STAR magic 2a 6c 01 00.

cases.name: wrong magic
cases.note: SPC-59.

cases.note: SPC-59: version byte 01.

cases.name: magic only
cases.note: SPC-59: the metadata is required.

cases.note: SPC-59: varints are in shortest form.

cases.note: SPC-59: the reference reads at most 6 varint bytes.

cases.note: SPC-59/60: the length is refused before reading (the frame is not present).

cases.note: SPC-60.

cases.note: SPC-60: EOF is allowed only at a pair boundary.

cases.note: SPC-60.

cases.note: SPC-60.

cases.name: key length padded with a zero byte
cases.note: SPC-59: varints are in shortest form.

cases.name: records out of order
cases.note: SPC-59/60: keys strictly increase.
cases.referenceError: RepoVerificationError: records out of order at com.example.note/3kbcq3p7ad400

cases.name: duplicate key
cases.note: SPC-59/60: no duplicate keys (the commit counts the record twice, so only the key order fails).

cases.note: SPC-59/60: each key is a record path {collection}/{rkey}.

cases.note: SPC-59/60: each key is a record path {collection}/{rkey}.

cases.name: key with two slashes
cases.note: SPC-59/60: each key is a record path {collection}/{rkey}.

cases.referenceError: RepoVerificationError: invalid record cbor at com.example.note/a

cases.name: record with keys out of canonical order
cases.note: SPC-17/60 require canonical encoding; the reference decodes it, hashes the bytes as sent and accepts it.

cases.name: record with a float
cases.note: SPC-17/60 forbid floats; the reference decoder accepts them.

cases.name: record with undefined
cases.note: SPC-17/60: undefined is not DRISL; the reference decoder reads it as null.

cases.name: a record of 1 MiB + 1 byte
cases.note: SPC-59/60: a record value is at most 1 MiB; the length is refused before the value is read.
